notes.title: BUG FIX PATCH – Food Cart Inc. | Version: Demo 12.06.2025
notes.content:
[p]Hey Food Cart masters!
During today’s live demo, we tracked several issues and quickly tackled many of them. Here are the key fixes and improvements based on what we observed:[/p][h3][b]🔧 General Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Order window alignment issue has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Prep time is now shown throughout the full countdown. It also activates at the end of each day.[/p][/*][*][p]Burnt items now change color and display a clear tooltip.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🍔 Order & Payment System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Customers no longer accept items that don’t match the original recipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Overpayment caused by extra ingredients has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The pricing system has been stabilized; incorrect high payments are fixed.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🧹 Cleanup & End-of-Day Behavior[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Toppings no longer remain on the table after the base item is trashed.[/p][/*][*][p]Leftover sauces on plates are now properly cleared at the end of the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Sauce bottles are no longer mistakenly deleted at day’s end.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📘 Codex & UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Missing or duplicate visuals have been cleaned up.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltip descriptions have been completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Containers no longer overlap with existing items on the table.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🧍‍♂️ Customers & Performance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]FPS drops and stuttering caused by excess money particles have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Frozen customer issues after performance drops have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]First customer arrival timing has been improved.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]💥 Critical Crash Fix[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A rare crash that caused the game to close unexpectedly has been fixed.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for all your feedback during the demo! Keep playing — more updates are on the way![/p][p]
[/p]
